sentence: This project develops techniques that improve how transformer models use memory so they run efficiently on mobile devices.
This project studies how lead pollution builds up in birds and how bird diets and habitats affect the lead in their bones.
This project studies stochastic partial differential equations, including the stochastic heat equation, using mathematical theory and computer simulations.
This project tracks how eating plants evolved in fossil vertebrates of the Permian Period by scanning their teeth in 3D.
This project builds a deep learning model that rebuilds fine-resolution turbulent flow data from coarse data, guided by physics.
This project studies how shock-driven liquid sheets break up into ligaments and droplets, using numerical simulations and detonation tube experiments.
This project builds lab models of trabecular bone marrow and a bioreactor to grow hematopoietic stem cells without letting them change.
This project studies the quark-gluon structure of pions and kaons, using beams of electrons or photons and AI methods to speed up analysis.
This project studies a way to match the phases of light waves in a specially designed waveguide by changing the light's polarization, without periodic poling.
This project studies how preparing a surface beforehand changes the thin metal films grown on it by atomic layer deposition.
This project studies attacks that poison machine learning systems used to detect cyber threats and builds defenses against them.
This project builds a way to describe how bumblebees perceive odors, using recordings of neural activity and odor learning tests.
This project builds tools that trace where medical AI training data came from, check it for tampering, and remove patient data from a model.
This project builds a computer framework that models human factors and schedules tasks so people and robots can work together in manufacturing.
This project studies how single-cell predators and their phytoplankton prey affect the chemical compounds released in the ocean.
This project uses mathematical models and plant census data to find out why plant species with different life history strategies live together.
This project studies how environmental noise affects the links between many quantum systems, using symmetries to simplify the math.
This project builds an instrument that combines optical imaging and electrochemical imaging to study chemical reactions at very small scales on electrode surfaces.
This project teaches robots to handle soft agricultural products by copying human demonstrations and sensing texture without touching them.
